description: This file contains the implementation of the Affiliate class within the OpenCart project, specifically in the namespace Opencart.Catalog.Model.Account. It provides methods for managing affiliate data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate information in the database.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Model class for handling affiliate data operations such as create, update, delete, and retrieve affiliate information.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Adds a new affiliate record associated with a customer ID, including setting tracking info, company, website, and other details.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates existing affiliate information for a given customer ID.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes the affiliate record associated with a specific customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves affiliate data for a given customer ID, including decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Finds an affiliate record based on a tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs an affiliate report with details like customer ID, IP, country, and store ID.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Removes report records associated with a specific customer ID.
